## Completed bounded lifecycle implementation — 28 October 2026

**COMPONENT_IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED_NOT_SOURCE_RELEASED.** [Exact final source `9a92ac92b29a127b1c38e6d0c052f8dc230dcb47`](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/commit/9a92ac92b29a127b1c38e6d0c052f8dc230dcb47) supplies internal Python API / SQLite profile **0.7.0**, additive migration **8**, and independently fixed expected/observed evidence. It follows [preimplementation concrete inputs/design `047a46c3a0e9bf0f776e2326fd75453338787042`](https://github.com/ArazSaieArasi3/riskium/commit/047a46c3a0e9bf0f776e2326fd75453338787042) and unchanged declaration #52 at `cb996241553fc8ae858acb38622009ed3a08f450`.

## Result and need

An issued C065 EvidenceReference can receive explicit same-artifact correction branches and documentary context-specific SELECT/WITHDRAW/CLEAR events. An exact artifact/context/as-of ledger query returns NO_SELECTION, SELECTED or WITHDRAWN. Original payloads, source JSON, item/target version pins, all branches and historical retrieval remain intact; a different context remains separate. This prevents implicit newest-version selection or destructive source/history updates.

The API is an internal Python function interface, not an HTTP deployment. Invalid input and forbidden SQL writes are rejected; failed issue/declaration operations roll back their version identity/event/allocator advance while preserving earlier outer transaction work. Earlier exact-schema readers deliberately reject v8.

## Actual results on the exact source

- **43/43 original frozen controls PASS** on local SQLite **3.53.1** and hosted SQLite **3.45.1**. Four inherited literal native graph oracles, three fixed wrong-query mutations and one separately counted actual weakened-withdrawal-guard control passed. Mutated rows are invalid sensitivity controls, not accepted domain data.
- **20 focused regression tests PASS** locally (23.941s) and in final hosted job **122926438746** (15.121s), including raw-SQL guards, source attribution, context/history separation, nested rollback, allocator integrity and prior/new restore audits.
- **395 full software tests PASS (213.736s)** inside the final candidate's actual checked receipt; **all 28 aggregate candidate gates PASS**.
- **All nine hosted workflows SUCCESS** on `9a92ac92b29a127b1c38e6d0c052f8dc230dcb47`, listed below.
- Independent download of final Actions artifact **12831701057** matched ZIP SHA-256 `64ed3ddfaf7b2c533780c97fd14b5267970a250beb2735248d15dfb83495c8c5`. All four asset checksum entries and every one of **1009 archived files** matched the per-file manifest and the exact Git blob inventory; source commit and publication_executed=false were checked.
- All **17 original source bindings**, **380 selected v0.3.4 files**, migrations 1–7, four frozen snapshots and the original 0.7.0 contract/expectations remain unchanged. All **306 native IDs/dispositions** remain accounted, **236 deferred**; no new native class/predicate/completed native mapping.
- The local full run initially stopped only its clean-source archive test before commit; that exact test then passed from a clean checkout. The final hosted full suite above independently passed all 395 tests in one run. The first dedicated hosted run passed feature checks but lacked BeautifulSoup for the documentation audit; final commit installs the already pinned publication requirements and updates only workflow/component/inventory metadata. No implementation defect or failing gate was waived.

- [x] Preserve the frozen 0.7.0 contract/fixtures and all original scientific/owner/source inputs, older components/migrations and v0.3.4 selected bindings.
- [x] Implement additive populated v7→v8 migration and audited Python write/read/recovery API with immutable same-artifact C065 correction branches, explicit context/as-of selection and documentary withdrawal/CLEAR behavior.
- [x] Execute all 43 predeclared expectations against actual SQLite; independently compare native graphs, query rows and migration/rollback/recovery results; execute actual wrong-query/weakened-rule controls.
- [x] Add meaningful regressions for SQL guards, malformed inputs, historical/context isolation, nested atomicity, source attribution and inherited schema/data audits.
- [x] Record exact schema dictionary/ownership/index rationale, requirement→actual result trace, all 306 unchanged native dispositions and a separately versioned development component.
- [x] Pass appropriate local/full/hosted checks, commit exact implementation and receipts, then close this finite child. Keep #51 open for current alignment/manuscript/docs/freeze/publication gates.



## Remaining release and research boundary

This completes **R2's bounded component**. #51 stays OPEN for R3/R4 current artifact/manuscript alignment, R5 separately versioned current documentation and actual Wiki/Pages readback, and R6 final source selection/freeze/publication/independent download. Broader #35/#12 remain open.

Original 423-row historical trace, scientific/owner inputs, model 0.3.1, ORSD 0.4.3, original DRSD 0.1.0, manuscript 7.0.8, all eleven WITHHELD organizational admissions and zero independent semantic ratings are retained. Source-qualified metadata is not truth, authority, occurrence or independent corroboration. General native assertions, reinstatement/notice correction, R-69..R-72, workflow/formulas, PostgreSQL/private migration and production acceptance retain their original issues. Paper P1–P6 are not completed by software engineering tests.

Original requirements/CQs, native clauses or supplementary omissions, code/query/fixed fixtures, actual expected/observed results/runtime, bounded claims/limits and actual paper dispositions remain inspectable.
